name: Our Little World
install:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -d /agent/repos/Our_little_world ]; then
  cd /agent/repos/Our_little_world
elif [ -d /agent/repos ]; then
  mapfile -t _olw_repos < <(find /agent/repos -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort)
  if [ "${#_olw_repos[@]}" -eq 1 ]; then
    cd "${_olw_repos[0]}"
  fi
fi
export OLW_PYTHON=python3
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
printf 'export OLW_PYTHON=python3\n' | sudo tee /etc/profile.d/olw-python.sh >/dev/null
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pil python-is-python3 ca-certificates
npm ci
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
node -e 'const [maj, min] = process.versions.node.split(".").map(Number); if (maj < 22 || (maj === 22 && min < 18)) { console.error("Node " + process.version + " is below 22.18"); process.exit(1); } console.log("Node", process.version);'
python3 -c 'import PIL; print("Pillow", PIL.__version__)'
start:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -d /agent/repos/Our_little_world ]; then
  cd /agent/repos/Our_little_world
elif [ -d /agent/repos ]; then
  mapfile -t _olw_repos < <(find /agent/repos -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort)
  if [ "${#_olw_repos[@]}" -eq 1 ]; then
    cd "${_olw_repos[0]}"
  fi
fi
export OLW_PYTHON=python3
if curl -fsS -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:4173/; then
  echo "Our Little World dev server already listening on 127.0.0.1:4173"
  exit 0
fi
exec npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 --strictPort
